answers.core: It is a small change that would best be integrated directly into the basic particle material.
answers.workaround: There are many ways to make footprints, and there are several work-arounds.  Such as using a custom particle shader.  However, I still think this feature could be useful for a wide variety of reasons involving particles.

title: Add an Emission Angle property to ParticlesMaterial to control the angle particles are initially emitted at
